what: The main collections were sorted by best selling. With no orders yet that means newest first, so the home page rows and the category pages opened with the clubs added last (Torino, Sporting, Rangers kids sets...), the NBA and basketball pages with 116 shorts, the kids page with the newest clubs' sets, and the special editions row with a BAPE print. They are now sorted by hand (MANUAL): big teams first, adults before kids, jerseys before shorts.
owner_instruction: The owner's reply to our list of open items on 2026-09-28: "סבבה טפל במה שצריך ברמה הגבוה ביותר". The list offered to put the big clubs and the jerseys first on the home page and the NBA page (CLAUDE.md, open items).
sort_order_before: BEST_SELLING on all 19 collections (no orders, so newest first in practice)
how_to_revert: Admin: Products > Collections > the collection > Sort > Best selling (or collectionUpdate with sortOrder BEST_SELLING). Worth doing once there are enough real sales.

football.order: 86 adult shirts first: the home shirts of the big clubs and national teams (Real Madrid, Barcelona, Manchester United, Manchester City, Arsenal, Chelsea, Bayern, PSG, Juventus 25/26 (no 26/27 yet), Milan, Inter, Atletico, Dortmund, Tottenham, Napoli, Argentina, Brazil, Portugal, Maccabi Haifa, Hapoel Tel Aviv, Al Nassr, Inter Miami...), then their away shirts, then their third shirts; the other adult shirts after them; the 152 kids sets at the end.

nba.order: The best four jerseys of the 18 most popular teams in turns (72: Lakers, Bulls/Jordan, Warriors, Celtics, Heat, Knicks, 76ers, Mavericks, Nets, Suns, Bucks, Nuggets, Thunder, Spurs, Timberwolves, Grizzlies, Cavaliers, Clippers); the other jerseys after them in their earlier order; then the 116 shorts and the 73 kids jerseys at the end.
